description: This is a test class for the PayGradeDao in the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It contains unit tests covering methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and filtering pay grade and currency data used in the HRM system.

classes.name: PayGradeDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the PayGradeDao functionalities, including CRUD operations and filtering for pay grades and associated currencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an instance of PayGradeDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a list of pay grades with expected count and names.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeById
methods.description: Checks that a pay grade retrieved by ID matches expected name.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of associated currencies for a given pay grade ID.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Validates retrieval of a specific currency for a pay grade by currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: testGetPayPeriods
methods.description: Ensures the list of pay periods contains expected entries.

methods.name: testGetCurrencies
methods.description: Checks that the list of available currencies matches expected count and IDs.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of currency entity by currency ID.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of pay grade currencies for a specific pay grade.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Validates retrieval of pay grade currency list filtered by pay grade.

methods.name: testGetPayGradesCount
methods.description: Checks total pay grades count with filtering applied.

methods.name: testSavePayGrade
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new pay grade entity.

methods.name: testSavePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new pay grade currency relation.

methods.name: testDeletePayGrades
methods.description: Ensures pay grades can be deleted by ID.

methods.name: testDeletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Ensures pay grade currencies can be deleted by pay grade ID and currency IDs.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of allowed pay currencies for a pay grade.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Checks count of allowed pay currencies filtered by pay grade.
